submission.justification: K3 has the best resolution but its assay result of 2.0 counts/kg/day is four times the 0.5 budget, so it is excluded. K1 (0.3) and K2 (0.1) both pass the background limit. K1 resolves far better than K2 (about 4.6–5.1% against about 8.5% from the 2025 summary). Simulated K1 resolution is flat with thickness within noise, roughly 4.6–5.1% across 2–8 cm. 5 cm gave the lowest value, 4.63%, but the differences between thicknesses are probably not significant. I did not simulate K2 at the new thicknesses, and I did not simulate K1 at 10 cm.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Best option within the background limit. K1 simulated at 4.63% FWHM at 5 cm, against K2 at about 8.5% (2025 summary only). K3 is better (2.9%) but fails the hard background limit.
K1 assay 0.3 counts/kg/day. K3 is 2.0 and fails. K2 is 0.1.
